# SMART Sniffer App (HAOS Add-on)

> SMART Sniffer App is a Home Assistant OS add-on that monitors the health of the
> drives in the HAOS machine -- the SSD or NVMe that Home Assistant OS runs on and any
> other drive it can see. It runs a lightweight S.M.A.R.T. agent inside the HA
> supervisor and shows this box's drives, read only, on its own page ("SMART Sniffer
> App"). The SMART Sniffer HACS integration (v0.9+) turns the data into native HA
> entities and has the Control Center for every machine.

Same Control Center. The App adds the drives of the box Home Assistant runs on. Install
the integration for everything else: other machines run the standalone agent, and the
integration's Control Center (a "SMART Sniffer" sidebar page for admins) shows them all.

Key behaviors:
- Reads S.M.A.R.T. data from the HAOS host drive via smartctl inside the HA container.
  Requires SYS_RAWIO and SYS_ADMIN capabilities plus full_access to drive device nodes,
  all configured automatically by the add-on.
- Exposes drive data via HTTP at 172.30.33.1:9099 by default.
- Advertises itself via mDNS so the SMART Sniffer integration can auto-discover it.
  The mDNS name is unique per HA instance (smartha-<ha-hostname>) to avoid collisions
  on multi-HA networks. Manual fallback: host 0449a086-smart-sniffer-agent, port 9099.
- With integration v0.9+ installed, posts a Supervisor discovery (service
  smart_sniffer, host and port only) so HA offers the agent as "SMART Sniffer (HAOS)".
- App 0.4.0 hands the field machines its 0.3.x page kept (address, port, password,
  names, hidden cards, order, thresholds) to integration v0.9+ once, and removes each
  from its options when the integration confirms it.
- Replicas (test drives) moved into the integration in App 0.4.0 / integration v0.9;
  the add-on no longer runs a replica agent.
- Shows disk space for USB drives mounted under /media (read-only) and for the data
  disk, also after the "move data disk" function puts it on an external drive. The drives
  are found when the add-on starts.
- The web UI is accessible from the HA sidebar as "SMART Sniffer App". It shows this
  machine's drives, pools and filesystems, read only, with a card that opens the
  integration's Control Center, or says how to install, update or finish updating
  (restart) the integration.
- Agentic access moved to the integration (Control Center footer, and
  /api/smart_sniffer/agentic.json for admin long-lived tokens).
- On some hardware, Protection Mode must be turned OFF (Settings -> Apps -> SMART
  Sniffer -> Protection mode) for the add-on to access drive device nodes.

Supported architectures: amd64, aarch64. armv7 was dropped in v0.2.12.

Configuration options:
- Agent Port (default: 9099)
- Bearer Token (optional, must match what is configured in the integration)
- Scan Interval in seconds (default: 60)
- Field Agents, Card Order, Hidden Cards, Thresholds, Card Names, Machine Names: what
  App 0.3.x kept. Field machines' entries are handed to the integration and removed;
  this box's thresholds still judge its cards on the App page.

What this add-on is NOT:
- Not an agent for remote machines -- install the standalone Go agent from smart-sniffer
  on NAS, Proxmox, workstations, Macs, and other machines, and add them in the
  integration's Control Center.
- Not a replacement for the integration -- the App's page shows this box without it,
  but other machines, entities, history, notifications, automations and replicas come
  from the SMART Sniffer HACS integration.
- Not available on HACS -- install by adding the repo URL to the HA add-on store.
- Not compatible with virtual disks (Proxmox VMs and similar) -- virtual drives may
  not support SMART commands.

## Repositories

- [smart-sniffer-app (this repo)](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app):
  Add-on source (smart_sniffer_agent/), configuration schema (repository.yaml), and
  the App's read-only page.
- [smart-sniffer](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer): Primary repo. HACS
  integration, standalone Go agent for remote machines, and all project documentation.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/README.md):
  Installation steps, configuration reference, the App's page, upgrading from 0.3.x, Security and Permissions
  section (why SYS_RAWIO/SYS_ADMIN are needed), and troubleshooting guide.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer-app/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md):
  Release history for the add-on.

## Optional

- [SMART Sniffer llms.txt](https://github.com/DAB-LABS/smart-sniffer/blob/main/llms.txt):
  Full project context: agent architecture, entity reference, Attention Needed
  classification logic, supported drive types, and design rationale.
